description: Retrieve a Pfam, CDD, or PIRSF clan/set and a cursor page of member entries; optionally include its relationship graph, returned in slices that fit the response budget and paged with relationshipOffset.

accession.description: Set accession, such as CL0016 (Pfam), cl21453 (CDD), or PIRSF000047; no URL syntax.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor with unchanged accession, sourceDatabase, and includeRelationships; limit, relationshipOffset, and includeThumbnail may change.

includeRelationships.description: Include the relationship graph, one slice per call that fits the response budget; defaults to false.

includeThumbnail.description: Include each Wikipedia thumbnail image, base64 data often tens of KB; defaults to false.

limit.description: Positive integer member page size; values above 100 are clamped to 100 with a notice; defaults to 20.

relationshipOffset.description: Position of the first relationship item to return, counting nodes, then links; defaults to 0. A value above 0 requires includeRelationships: true; pass relationshipsPage.nextOffset to continue.

sourceDatabase.description: Inferred from uppercase CL (Pfam), lowercase cl (CDD), or PIRSF; supply explicitly for mixed-case CL prefixes.

name: interpro_get_clan

cap.description: Effective member page size after clamping.

clan.description: Complete metadata, with relationships and Wikipedia thumbnails omitted unless requested; requested relationships hold the slice relationshipsPage locates.

effectiveQuery.description: Applied canonical target, relationship, and thumbnail selection.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `database_mismatch`: Explicit database conflicts with accession routing. `accession_source_unknown`: Accession has no inferred or explicit database. `relationships_not_requested`: relationshipOffset above 0 is supplied without includeRelationships: true; 0 is accepted as a no-op. `clan_not_found`: Set metadata returns 204 or 404. `entry_withdrawn`: Entry or set returns 410. `invalid_cursor`: Cursor decoding or scope fails, or upstream rejects continuation. `upstream_shape_invalid`: Upstream JSON, structure, or continuation is incompatible. `upstream_response_too_large`: An upstream response exceeds 4 MiB. `upstream_rejected`: InterPro returns an unhandled redirect or client rejection. `upstream_unavailable`: InterPro has a network or server failure; HTTP 501 is not retryable. `upstream_timeout`: InterPro returns HTTP 408/504 or an attempt exceeds its deadline. `upstream_rate_limited`: InterPro returns HTTP 429. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Next relationship slice call, omitted relationships or thumbnails, or empty-page guidance.

limit.description: Effective page size after clamping to the tool maximum.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation with unchanged target and filters.

relationshipsPage.description: Position and totals of the relationship slice; present only when includeRelationships is true.

hasMore.description: Whether nodes or links remain after this slice.

nextOffset.description: relationshipOffset of the next slice; present only when hasMore is true.

offset.description: Requested relationshipOffset: position of the first returned item among every node sorted by accession, followed by every link sorted by source, target, and method.

sourceUrl.description: Official clan metadata API source URL.

title: InterPro clan metadata and members
